entities.name: Henri Lopès
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Henri Lopes was a Congolese writer, diplomat, and politician. He was Prime Minister of Congo-Brazzaville from 1973 to 1975, and served as Congo-Brazzaville's Ambassador to France from 1998 to 2016.
